description.value:
Duration constant

Everything you carry is technically a demolition tool, and you have never once been careless with one.

Your two-handed melee weapon Strikes deal an additional die of the weapon's damage type against creatures that are prone, immobilized, restrained, grabbed, or have no space to retreat into. Your allies are never damaged by your own area effects, collapses, or structural failures — you have always known exactly where the people you like are standing.

cinderfall.incomplete: The extra-damage-die-vs-condition clause reuses this class's own already-shipped DamageDice idiom (deadhand.one-weapon-one-answer.json). "Allies are never damaged by the caster's own AoE/collapses" is unbuilt: no rule element excludes named allies from the caster's own area damage based on relationship.
